An Ordinance

[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 8th August, 2002]
No. Legis.13-33/2002, dated
8-8-2002. The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Lahore Development
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

in clause (b) the word "Metropolitan" shall be substituted by the words

(ii)
in clause (d) the words "Deputy Commissioner" wherever occurring
shall be substituted by the words
"District Coordination Officer";
(iii)
after clause (d) the following new clause (dd) shall be inserted: -

"District Government" means City District Government consisting of

Ordinance, 2001 (XIII of 2001);";
(iv)
in clause (f) sub-clause (ii) shall be substituted by the following:--
"(ii)
a Local Government as defined ~ in the Punjab Local, Government Ordinance, 2001 (XIII of 2001);
and";
(v)
in clause (f) sub-clause (iii), the words "municipal body" shall be
substituted by the words "Local
Government"; and.
(vi)
after clause (h) the following new clause (hh) shall be inserted:
"(hh)
"Nazim" means Zila Nazim or Town Nazim, as the case may be;".

is hereby published for general information:
7. Substitution of section 19
of Act XXX of 1975.---In the said Act, section 19 shall be substituted by
the following:--
"19. Power to Act as a
Local Government. ---During such period and for such locality, as the
District Government may, by notification, specify, the Authority may,
notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in
force, exercise and perform such powers and functions as a Local Government may
exercise and perform under the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 (XIII of
2001)."

An Ordinance

[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 8th August, 2002]
No. Legis.13-33/2002, dated
8-8-2002. The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information:
10. Substitution of section 31
of Act XXX of 1975.---In the said Act, section 31 shall be substituted by
the following:--
"31. The Authority shall prepare
every year and at such time as may be prescribed, a budget in respect of the
financial year next ensuring showing the estimated receipts and expenditure of
the Authority and each of its Agencies and shall submit the same through
District Government to the Zila Council for approval. After approval the budget
of the Authority shall be reflected in the budget of the District Government.
If the Zila Council does not approve or modify the budget within thirty days of
its receipt, the budget as prepared by the Authority shall be deemed to be the
approved budget."
